text:
rachel: FYI merged kv-coalesce-small-chunks PR (D3190) yesterday; perf env reporting OOM spikes on longctx e2e (seqlen 4096 / 2048) after rollout :eyes:
liam: saw CI perf fail too — https://ci.redwood.example/runs/12345 seqlen=2048 mem use up ~2.3x
sam: can you paste the perf flame or alloc profile?
marta: adding bisect label, running git-bisect between revert point and head
infra-bot: perf-ci: job kv-longctx/2048 failed — artifacts at https://ci.redwood.example/artifacts/12345
rachel: attaching quick heap diff from perf host:
```
heap_alloc_before=12.1GB
heap_alloc_after=27.8GB
hot slabs: kv_small_chunks: +14.2GB
backtrace: runtime::kv::coalesce_small_chunks
```
liam: interesting — the new threshold lowered chunk size floor, increasing fragmentation; looks like many tiny slab hits. maybe the coalesce window is too small for longctx
sam: profile (perf top) shows hot path in kernel_selection when chunk_count>512
rachel: repro script:
```
./scripts/run_longctx.sh --model llama --seqlen 4096 --warmup 5 --iters 20
```
marta: bisect suggests bad commit d4f7c9 -> introduced new chunk policy
liam: can we try reverting only the size floor change and keep other improvements? I'll open PR
rachel: opened draft revert PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4512
sam: quick test locally: reverting size_floor to 512 reduces mem back to ~13GB
marta: rolling back to canary paused — hold rollout until revert merges :thumbsup:
infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout paused for group: eng-runtime (reason: memory regression)
liam: follow-up: need a longer-term fix — maybe adaptive coalesce that considers seq_len distribution + per-tenant avg
rachel: created issue with profiling artifacts: https://issues.redwood.example/IR-678
sam: adding comments re: kernel routing — may need kernel selection tweak so small chunks use different allocator
marta: thanks all — will schedule patch + postmortem tomorrow
rachel: +1, dropping logs and heapdumps to S3: s3://redwood-perf/kb/2888880000/
liam: thx — will run perf traces once artifacts available
